findings.result: Regorus has real, pinned Verus verification infrastructure: Cargo metadata enables verification, a verus feature activates vstd, vstd is exactly version-pinned, and the CI workflow downloads a specific Verus release with an exact SHA-256, installs the toolchain declared by that release, runs cargo fetch --locked, then runs cargo verus verify --locked --features verus.
findings.scope_guard: Workflow configuration proves a reproducible verification route exists; it does not by itself prove every source module or every Rego semantic path carries machine-checked contracts.

findings.result: Targeted exact source searches for verus_verify and vstd:: each surfaced src/number.rs. The inspected source imports vstd only behind the verus feature and directly annotates F64_SAFE_INTEGER with cfg_attr(..., verus_verify). No inspected evidence established parser/interpreter/compiler/RVM semantic correctness contracts under Verus. The worker's narrow claim that the visible proof surface is far smaller than the repository-wide CI command is supported.
findings.scope_guard: This is a targeted current-source observation, not a universal proof that no indirect/generated Verus obligations exist outside the searched surfaces. The safe statement is that direct visible annotations/imports found by these exact searches are localized.

findings.result: Issue #712 is a third-party, environment-specified reproducer against Regorus 0.9.1. It reports that a partial rule with an iterating dynamic key emitted only one binding in both the Regorus CLI and library API, while OPA 1.16.1 emitted all three; an equivalent comprehension worked. This is materially stronger than a maintainer-only retrospective because it supplies a minimal external reproducer and an independent reference implementation contrast.
findings.scope_guard: This establishes a historical Regorus 0.9.1 defect for the reported rule shapes, not a defect in all versions or all partial-rule semantics.

findings.result: Merged PR #718 explicitly identifies two independent defects: interpreter early-return constness failed to account for a dynamic key, and the RVM classified bracket-headed p[k] rules as PartialSet rather than PartialObject. The patch adds the dynamic-key constness check, corrects RVM rule typing, guards unsupported shapes, and adds broad regression cases. The exact fixes are still present on audited current main.
findings.scope_guard: The current regression file also contains skipped TODO #719 cases, including undefined-key and conflicting-duplicate behavior. Therefore the repaired PR is not evidence that the RVM is semantically complete or bug-free.

findings.result: The PR #718 head had successful repository CI across debug/release tests, clippy, no-std and multiple language bindings including Wasm. This supports integration quality of the fix. It is not evidence that Verus checked this historical repair, because the Verus workflow is a separate later verification surface and was not established as part of that PR run set.
findings.scope_guard: CI success supports the exact tested build/test matrix only.

findings.result: The observed dual interpreter/RVM fault plus external OPA disagreement gives strong empirical motivation for generated cross-implementation/cross-compiled differential testing. But the worker's proposed seed-replayable, shrinkable generated semantic campaign has not itself been executed or shown to reduce production defect rate. Treat it as a high-value experimental design, not as an already validated assurance mechanism.
findings.scope_guard: Do not convert historical bug evidence into a causal claim about the benefit size of future fuzzing/differential infrastructure.

reproduction_status.published_or_reported_claim: Historical Regorus 0.9.1 partial-rule defect and current Verus-infrastructure observations are directly sourceable.
reproduction_status.official_artifact_support: Strong: exact source, workflow, merged repair, current regression corpus and current fix persistence are public.
reproduction_status.independent_replication: Strong for the historical defect: external issue #712 provides a minimal Regorus-vs-OPA reproducer. No independent replication is needed to establish the narrower direct-source observation that current visible Verus annotation use is localized, though an independent full Verus run would strengthen operational reproducibility.
reproduction_status.failed_replication: None located for the exact repaired all-bindings regression on current main in this audit.
reproduction_status.missing_dependencies_or_config: No material dependency gap for inspecting the repair. The Verus route is unusually well pinned by release asset hash, lockfile use and release-declared Rust toolchain. This invocation did not independently execute Verus locally.
reproduction_status.o_specific_adaptation: None. The proposed generated multi-oracle differential/certificate campaign is a worker design implication and remains unexecuted.

decision_boundary.safe_positive: Use the Regorus case as direct evidence that implementation and compiled-backend semantic paths can fail independently and that broad verification commands must be interpreted according to the actual annotated/proved source surface.
unsafe_overreach: Do not say Regorus current main still has the exact #712 bug; the fix persists and regression tests cover it.
Do not say Regorus is formally verified end-to-end because cargo verus verify runs repository-wide.
Do not say generated differential fuzzing has already improved Regorus reliability; that campaign is still a proposed experiment.
Do not infer RVM semantic completeness from PR #718 because current regression cases still mark known gaps as skipped.

reopen_conditions: A generated seed-persistent, shrinkable Regorus interpreter-vs-RVM or Regorus-vs-OPA semantic differential harness becomes public or is executed with durable mismatch artifacts.
The visible Verus proof surface expands materially into parser/interpreter/compiler/RVM semantics or a machine-checked semantic-preservation result is published.
Issue #719-class skipped RVM gaps are repaired with executable regression evidence or an independent current-main reproduction finds a new divergence.
A reproducible current-main Verus run or proof-obligation inventory materially changes the operational proof-surface assessment.
exact_next_action: On the next bootstrap-valid invocation, freeze the then-current exact wave and audit a different source-qualified non-evaluation candidate with executable or independently reproducible evidence; do not repeat C440/C441 unless a reopen condition occurs.
